name: cfcmt-bus-free-execution-actor-v1

evaluation.test_separation: Predefined before new training or evaluation; disjoint from fit/stop/calibration, smoke and all previous evaluation cohorts. Same pinned services and generated OD intensities.
evaluation.comparison: 48 prospective evaluations: free-state actor mask18, prior entropyOFF unmasked18, adapted55k9, rule3.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

asset_selection.ordering: Original route, direction, pattern and service id, before any control outcomes
asset_selection.network: GTFS-derived route corridors; APC-apportioned demand, generated destinations; not a measured city road network
asset_selection.calendar_rule: Earliest weekday in the pinned GTFS feed with active weekday service and without a holiday exception; keep the original 12-service subset
asset_selection.calendar_provenance: Actual trip_id/service_id and full stop signatures from GTFS; never merge mutually exclusive calendar services or clamp zero scheduled headways

checkpoint_rule: All six new policies use fixed final20k from original55k plus loaded optimizers; prior unmasked entropyOFF uses its fixed final20k, adapted55k remains a fewer-update stage reference. No outcome-based model selection.
intervention: Only mask actor IQL weights to zero where canonical execution bounds collapse. The same raw labels/weights and all replay rows remain for critic, V, model generation/trust. Original full batch N denominator; no free-row renormalization or replacement replay draws. Entropy backup remains OFF.
boundary: Remove actor gradient from the physically constant forced60 action. Fixed-checkpoint gradient norms motivated a single necessary correction, but do not establish that it causes performance loss.
limits: Only this fixed Halifax service and generated OD; no cross-city generality.
Current OFF forced gradients are smaller than free gradients, so no promised cost improvement or causal dominance.
Three free fit labels at the upper bound still use raw continuous density rather than tail mass in both arms; the experiment changes only collapsed-state actor gradients.
Adapted55k is a fewer-update stage reference; source and normalized confidence contribution remain unisolated.
No temperature, threshold, batch denominator, model, seed, city or checkpoint selection after outcomes.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen runtime and inputs only; no mutable Thesis access; no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
fixed_training: Six20k continuations from original seed-matched adapted55k; existing optimizer/RNG replay/WM/trust and model0/.25 unchanged. Only actor weights for collapsed execution states become zero; TD backup remains entropyOFF, temperature algorithm retained.
entropy_interpretation: SAC latent-temperature sampling/update is retained only as the frozen algorithm path. Actor uses recorded likelihood, and alpha is excluded from real/model TD targets. No estimate of execution-action entropy is added.
admission: Actual seed75101 TD0/.25 paired four-step unmasked/masked entropyOFF; original replay/RNG and first critic/V/alpha/TD/model update equality; exact masked native IQL loss and zero collapsed actor weights; all four optimizers step four times, no simulation/checkpoint writes.
reporting_interpretation: 48 actual fresh evaluations demand72551-72553/SUMO73551-73553; mask18/unmaskedOFF18/adapted9/rule3. Equal case/seed weights; preserve all final artifacts, no old-case pooling or population CI.
actor_objective: Negative mean raw recorded log likelihood times existing detached IQL weights times free-execution indicator; same original batchN. Critic/V use original unmasked records/weights. No extra coefficient, replay draw, V update or free-row normalization.
temperature_interpretation: The SAC latent-temperature sample retains its original pre-actor-step position and random draws; alpha optimizer updates remain after the actor step. Alpha trajectories may diverge as actors diverge; no freeze, clamp or retuning.
